PR: Misc package revision fixes from debugging `TestDowngrade` E2E failures [closed]
### Description of your changes

This is a bunch of commits I made while debugging and attempting to fix https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/issues/6413. I don't expect any of the commits to fix that issue, but they all feel like small improvements worth doing.

The most impactful change is that we'll now reconcile all package revisions whenever the lock changes. I noticed while debugging #6413 that the system got into a state where an active package revision existed but wasn't in the lock. I think anothe…

revision removed it, and it was never reconciled again to re-add itself (see #6413 for details).

I think this change is also necessary for a package revision to become healthy when it's blocked on a dependency. Without this change, I don't see how an existing package revision would know when a dependency it'd been blocked on was later installed.
